t: That the second regular session of the Ninetieth Congress shall begin at noon on Monday, January 15, 1968.

fable.w: The section only sets the date and time on which the second regular session of the Ninetieth Congress convenes. Congress is inside the federal government, and no outside party (states, public, experts, companies) is consulted, heard, or given a right to sue over any federal decision. There is no tempting participation reading here beyond the fact that it concerns a congressional session, which is purely internal scheduling.

qwen_block.w: This section simply sets the start date for a session of Congress. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. Congress is an internal part of the federal government, and scheduling its sessions does not constitute public participation.
qwen_block.s: That the second regular session of the Ninetieth Congress shall begin at noon on Monday, January 15, 1968.

opus.w: The section only sets the start date for the second regular session of the Ninetieth Congress. That is an internal scheduling matter for Congress, which is inside the federal government. No outside party is consulted, heard, or given a role in any federal decision. A word like "session" might suggest procedure, but nothing here involves participation by anyone outside the government.
opus.b: This section only sets the date a congressional session begins. The word "session" might sound procedural, but it doesn't bring anyone from outside the federal government into a federal decision. There is no hearing, comment period, consultation, advisory body, rulemaking or right to sue.
